sections.title: Items
sections.note: The Item Screen and the five Mystical Seeds. Swords, shields and other upgradable items are under Upgrades.

items.name: Seed Satchel
items.howTo: The dungeon item of the Gnarled Root Dungeon, down the stairs behind a pushable block past the Goriya Brothers.
items.notes: Comes with 20 Ember Seeds. Its capacity is under Upgrades.

items.name: Bombs
items.howTo: A chest the mine cart passes in the Gnarled Root Dungeon holds 10 Bombs. The Horon Village Shop also sells 10 for 20 Rupees.
items.notes: Bomb capacity is under Upgrades.

items.name: Ember Seeds
items.howTo: Twenty come with the Seed Satchel. The Ember Tree is in Horon Village, west of Dr. Left's house.
items.notes: Burn trees and light torches. Holodrum's Mystical Trees bear seeds in one season each: the Ember Tree in winter.

items.name: Rod of Seasons
items.howTo: Stand on the pedestal at the temple's central altar on your first trip to Subrosia.
items.notes: Swing it on a tree stump to change the season. The four seasons are in the Rod of Seasons tracker.

items.name: Shovel
items.howTo: In winter, walk up the snowdrift to Holly's chimney and drop in. She gives you the Shovel to clear her walkway.

items.name: Mystery Seeds
items.howTo: The Mystery Tree stands past the snow you dig through near Holly's house, on the way to Snake's Remains.
items.notes: Random effect; wakes Owl Statues for hints. The tree bears seeds in summer.

items.name: Power Bracelet
items.howTo: The dungeon item of Snake's Remains.
items.notes: Oracle of Seasons has no Power Glove.

items.name: Strange Flute
items.howTo: Ricky gives you Ricky's Flute after you return his gloves, unless you already have a Strange Flute: buy one at the Horon Village Shop (150 Rupees) for Moosh, or win one at the Subrosian Dance Hall for Dimitri.
items.notes: Both Strange Flutes are offered after Snake's Remains and only until you help Ricky. See Animal Companions.

items.name: Scent Seeds
items.howTo: The Scent Tree is on the way from Ricky to Blaino's Gym.
items.notes: Lure enemies; the strongest Slingshot ammunition. The tree bears seeds in spring.

items.name: Pegasus Seeds
items.howTo: The Pegasus Tree is at the entrance to Spool Swamp.
items.notes: Run faster and jump farther; shot, they freeze enemies. The tree bears seeds in autumn.

items.name: Fool's Ore
items.howTo: The Strange Brothers swap it for your Roc's Feather when you first cross the lava from the Mt. Cucco portal.
items.notes: It replaces Roc's Feather until you follow the brothers through the Treasure Grove and dig the feather up, then it's gone for good. It hits harder than any sword.

items.name: Gale Seeds
items.howTo: From the Gale Tree in Sunken City, in summer. A second Gale Tree grows in the Tarm Ruins.
items.notes: Warp to any Mystical Tree you've touched; shot, they blow enemies away.

items.name: Magnetic Gloves
items.howTo: The dungeon item of Unicorn's Cave.
items.notes: Swap polarity to pull yourself to S stones or push and pull iron balls.

items.name: Bombchus
items.howTo: Only through linking secrets with Oracle of Ages: the Subrosian Secret (cut a cave's grass with three Boomerang throws) or the Troy Secret told to Farore. Afterwards Syrup sells them, 5 for 100 Rupees.

items.name: Biggoron's Sword
items.howTo: Only through linking secrets with Oracle of Ages: tell Biggoron the Biggoron Secret, or tell Farore the Elder Secret.
items.notes: The strongest sword. It takes both the A and B slots.

sections.title: Upgrades
sections.note: Each tap does the next upgrade in order. Linked-only steps say so. The Ring Box is in the rings tracker.

items.name: Sword

tiers.name: Wooden Sword
tiers.howTo: In a chest in the Hero's Cave on the Western Coast. In a Linked Game you start with it.

tiers.name: Noble Sword
tiers.howTo: Finish the trading sequence: play the Phonograph for the Business Scrub in the Lost Woods, and he tells you the way to the sword's pedestal.

tiers.name: Master Sword (Linked)
tiers.howTo: Linked only: the Clock Shop Secret (beat the old man's 30-second challenge under the Horon Village clock shop) or the King Zora Secret told to Farore.

items.notes: If a secret gives you the Noble Sword first, the Lost Woods pedestal holds the Master Sword instead.

items.name: Shield

tiers.name: Wooden Shield
tiers.howTo: Buy it at the Horon Village Shop for 30 Rupees, or trade 5 Ember Seeds for it at Subrosia Market (sold as a cutting board).

tiers.name: Iron Shield
tiers.howTo: Have Red and Blue Ore smelted into Hard Ore at the Great Furnace, then bring it and your Wooden Shield to the Subrosian Smithy.

tiers.name: Mirror Shield (Linked)
tiers.howTo: Linked only: the Library Secret told to Farore, or the Smith Secret told to the master smith. With the Iron Shield already, the smithy's Hard Ore makes the Mirror Shield.

items.notes: If a Like Like eats your shield, shops sell a replacement.

tiers.name: Roc's Feather
tiers.howTo: The dungeon item of Poison Moth's Lair.

tiers.name: Roc's Cape
tiers.howTo: The dungeon item of the Explorer's Crypt. Jump, then glide over three spaces.

items.name: Boomerang

tiers.name: Boomerang
tiers.howTo: Dance a whole round without bumping anyone at the Subrosian Dance Hall.

tiers.name: Magical Boomerang
tiers.howTo: The dungeon item of the Ancient Ruins. Steer it with the Control Pad.

items.notes: The first Boomerang is optional (a bomb also hits the Tower of Winter switch); the Magical Boomerang is required.

tiers.name: Slingshot
tiers.howTo: The dungeon item of the Dancing Dragon Dungeon.

tiers.name: Hyper Slingshot
tiers.howTo: The dungeon item of the Sword & Shield Maze. Fires three seeds for the price of one.

items.name: Seed Satchel capacity

tiers.name: 50 of each seed
tiers.howTo: Buy the upgrade for 300 Rupees in the Horon Village Shop's basement, which needs the Member's Card.

tiers.name: 99 of each seed (Linked)
tiers.howTo: Linked only: the Deku Secret told to the Deku Scrub in Natzu, or the Tingle Secret told to Farore.

items.notes: Starts at 20 of each. The shop and the secret can come in either order; the second makes it 99.

items.name: Bomb capacity

tiers.name: 30 Bombs
tiers.howTo: Buy the Big Bomb Bag (a red bomb that explodes in your hands) at Subrosia Market for 50 Ore Chunks and 10 Bombs.

tiers.name: 50 Bombs (Linked)
tiers.howTo: Linked only: tell the Pirate Secret to the Piratian at the House of Pirates while holding exactly 777 Ore Chunks, or tell Farore the Tokay Secret.

items.notes: Starts at 10.

sections.title: Quest Items
sections.note: The Quest Status screen, roughly in the order you find them. Essences are in Main Quest; rings, Gasha Seeds and trade items have their own trackers.

items.name: Gnarled Key
items.howTo: The Maku Tree gives it when you wake him.
items.notes: Opens the Gnarled Root Dungeon.

items.name: Star-Shaped Ore
items.howTo: Dig in the sand with the Shovel until you find it.
items.notes: Traded for the Ribbon. Also in the Subrosia tracker.

items.name: Ribbon
items.howTo: Trade the Star-Shaped Ore for it.
items.notes: Rosa's lost Ribbon. Give it back and she goes on a 'date' with you, opening the Tower of Summer. Also in the Subrosia tracker.

items.name: Ricky's Gloves
items.howTo: Pay Blaino 10 Rupees and knock him out of the ring, using no items or rings.
items.notes: Return them to Ricky. Also in Animal Companions.

items.name: Floodgate Key
items.howTo: In the Floodgate Keeper's House, where the keeper misplaced it.
items.notes: Its keyhole is through the tunnel outside; opening the floodgate drains the way to Poison Moth's Lair.

items.name: Master's Plaque
items.howTo: In the cave above a waterfall only Dimitri can climb, push the four eye statues close together and hit them all with one spin attack.
items.notes: Take it to the Master Diver.

items.name: Zora's Flippers
items.howTo: The Master Diver gives them for the Master's Plaque.
items.notes: Swim, and dive with B. He also tells you of the underwater passage to Mt. Cucco near Ingo's house.

items.name: Spring Banana
items.howTo: In spring, carry a Flying Cucco with the Power Bracelet to fly up to the eastern summit, where the banana tree grows.
items.notes: Feed it to Moosh.

items.name: Dragon Key
items.howTo: Past a field of pits that only Moosh can fly over.
items.notes: Stops the waterfall over the Dancing Dragon Dungeon.

items.name: Bomb Flower
items.howTo: Jump across Lava Lake with Roc's Feather to the lone flower and pull it up with the Power Bracelet.
items.notes: The Subrosian Smelter blasts the rubble at the Tower of Autumn with it. Also in the Subrosia tracker.

items.name: Member's Card
items.howTo: Buy it for 5 Ore Chunks.
items.notes: Lets you into the Horon Village Shop's basement (Treasure Map, satchel upgrade, Gasha Seeds). Also in the Subrosia tracker.

items.name: Treasure Map
items.howTo: Buy it for 200 Rupees in the Horon Village Shop's basement.
items.notes: Marks the four jewels on the map. Optional.

items.name: Red Ore
items.howTo: In a chest atop the cliff in southeastern Subrosia Village: cross the pits with the Magnetic Gloves to the cave below it.
items.notes: Also in the Subrosia tracker.

items.name: Blue Ore
items.howTo: In a chest in the western Subrosian Wilds, across pits you cross with the Magnetic Gloves.
items.notes: Also in the Subrosia tracker.

items.name: Hard Ore
items.howTo: The Subrosian Smelter smelts it from the Red Ore and Blue Ore.
items.notes: The Subrosian Smithy makes your shield from it. Also in the Subrosia tracker.

items.name: X-Shaped Jewel
items.howTo: Light the brazier in the water with an Ember Seed from the Slingshot to raise a bridge to the islet, put a Mystery Seed on the question-mark rock and beat the monster that appears.
items.notes: One of the four jewels for the Tarm Ruins gate.

items.name: Pyramid Jewel
items.howTo: In spring, dive in the upper-right corner of the pool outside the Dancing Dragon Dungeon and follow the underwater cave.
items.notes: In a Linked Game it's elsewhere: Vire throws it onto a ledge at the base of the Sunken Falls after you open a nearby chest.

items.name: Square Jewel
items.howTo: In winter, reach the southeast corner of Spool Swamp, clear the snow and bomb open the cave.
items.notes: In a Linked Game it's in a cave behind a bombable wall under Eyeglass Lake, in summer.

items.name: Round Jewel
items.howTo: An old man in a tree house in southern Holodrum Plain, reached by swimming, gives it once you have five Essences.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon says he wants all four season powers instead; Zelda Wiki and StrategyWiki say five Essences.

items.name: Pirate's Bell

tiers.name: Rusty Bell
tiers.howTo: In the Samasa Desert, carry the pirate's skull from the oasis with the Power Bracelet; jump into the quicksand pit where it starts to shatter.

tiers.name: Pirate's Bell
tiers.howTo: Make the Subrosian Smithy polish it: insist rather than ask nicely.

items.notes: The Cap'n won't sail without it. The desert gate opens with the drawer combination a Piratian shows you at the House of Pirates. Also in the Subrosia tracker.

items.name: Huge Maku Seed
items.howTo: The Maku Tree gives it once you have all eight Essences of Nature.
items.notes: Breaks the barrier around Onox's Castle.
